universe.name: Mechanical Pinball Metropolis
universe.why: A vintage mechanical pinball machine perfectly captures the frenetic energy of money bouncing around the tech industry, the complex plumbing of investment loops, and the inevitable 'tilt' of an overloaded system.
universe.pacing: Kinetic and snappy, slowing down for a moment of eerie realization before escalating to a vibrating, overloaded finale.
universe.signature_shot: Hundreds of silver pinballs vibrating wildly on a glowing neon playfield, reflecting off the glass under an amber 'TILT?' sign.
universe.medium_break: The camera pulls back to the glass covering the playfield, revealing the reflection of the arcade room lights above the miniature tech city.
universe.look_bible: Macro photography of a vintage-style mechanical pinball machine built like a miniature tech city. Materials include rich mahogany wood, shiny silver steel pinballs, polished brass wireform ramps, and a detailed painted enamel playfield. The lighting is moody arcade lighting with deep shadows, illuminated by bright glowing neon pops of cyan, emerald green, and amber. The lens is a macro lens creating a shallow depth of field with beautiful, cinematic bokeh on the glowing background lights. Motion feels physical, heavy, and kinetic, with hard, snappy mechanical physics.
universe.penguin_render: A tiny, glossy enamel-painted metal penguin figure with white eye-rings, orange feet, and three bent wire feathers on its head.
universe.music: A driving, mechanical instrumental loop with snappy rhythmic clicks, deep synth bass, and vintage arcade chime melodies.

penguin.arc: Wanders onto the playfield to investigate a dark sinkhole, and is later seen fruitlessly trying to fly off a brass wire ramp.

shots.motion: Camera tracks rapidly up the wooden plunger chute as the silver pinballs launch and spill onto the playfield.
shots.sfx: Heavy mechanical spring launching, followed by rolling steel balls on wood.

shots.motion: Camera drifts forward, following the cluster of silver pinballs as they roll aggressively toward the central bumper.
shots.sfx: Rolling steel rumble and mechanical clicking.

shots.motion: Camera pushes in tightly on the central bumper as the silver balls strike it, triggering bright neon green flashes.
shots.sfx: Snappy, resonant electronic arcade bumper chimes.

shots.motion: Camera tracks smoothly down the polished brass ramp, matching the speed of the rolling silver pinball.
shots.sfx: Smooth metallic rolling sound of steel on brass wire.

shots.motion: Camera pans right as the pinball strikes the targets, following the sudden wave of cyan neon light turning on.
shots.sfx: Heavy mechanical clacks of drop targets falling, followed by a powering-up hum.

shots.motion: Camera pulls back and tilts down, revealing the mechanical flippers rapidly batting a barrage of silver balls upward.
shots.sfx: Loud, rhythmic clacking of pinball flippers engaging rapidly.

shots.motion: Camera watches the ball drop, then drifts left to land on the mechanical score counter spinning zeroes.
shots.sfx: A hollow wooden clunk as the ball drops, followed by the dry clicking of score reels spinning without payout.

shots.motion: Camera pans right off the zeroed score counter, revealing the hidden brass loop as a silver ball rockets into it.
shots.sfx: A sharp mechanical solenoid click and a swoosh of the ball launching.

shots.motion: Camera tracks the silver pinball seamlessly up the curved brass wireform loop.
Camera pushes in as the ball completes the loop, crashing forcefully back into the green central bumper.
shots.sfx: A resonant, snappy arcade bumper chime.

shots.motion: Camera pushes in steadily as the blueprint schematic of the router bumper abruptly shatters into technical lines.
shots.sfx: A sharp, synthesized glass-shatter sound mixed with a digital error tone.

shots.motion: Camera tilts up slowly from the quiet, dusty section to the chaotic, glowing neon section above filled with balls.
shots.sfx: A low, ominous mechanical hum that builds in intensity.

shots.motion: Camera pulls back to reveal the full scope of the machine as it begins to vibrate violently under the strain.
shots.sfx: The chaotic cacophony of hundreds of steel balls bouncing and heavy mechanical rattling.

shots.motion: Camera pushes in toward the playfield glass, focusing sharply on the flickering amber 'TILT?' reflection as the machine shakes.
shots.sfx: A loud, buzzing electrical fault sound, cutting to abrupt silence on the final frame.

cover.prompt: Macro photography of a vintage mechanical pinball machine playfield covered in hundreds of silver pinballs. The thick glass covering the machine reflects a glowing neon amber 'TILT?' sign. Moody arcade lighting, deep shadows, cinematic bokeh.
